_comment: Which wireframe covers which visualiser THIS instance (smart-base) declares, by route key `<instance>/<visualiser>`. The same shape as the platform's own docs/wireframes/index.json, which held this entry until 2026-10-20: a wireframe sits with the page it draws, and check:wireframes reads the `wireframes/` of every `docs` directory an instance declares (cat-harness-tools#281). In the platform's index this ref named a layer above it (wrong-direction move M3). It is here, under `findings/`, because `docs/` is built at publish and commits nothing; and it is in this instance rather than the FHIR IG layer because the visualiser it covers, `artifact-index`, is declared by this instance, and the drawing is of a WHO SMART IG's page (its banner, canonical and DAK API section), which the FHIR IG layer may not name. `wireframe.css` is the shared mid-fidelity stylesheet, copied from the platform's docs/wireframes/ so the drawing renders here on its own.
